��

Motivation is concerned with the  why of behavior.�

The key question relating to motivation is  What s in it for me?


Educators are especially interested in the motivational aspect of learning.�

If a teacher understands why students learn, this knowledge can be used to motivate the students toward greater learning.�

Generally speaking, we learn best when:

  • We are interested
  • We have the desire to learn
  • We have the intention to learn
  • The material is meaningful to us.
  • We can relate and apply the material�
  • We are learning to our own lives.

Thus, motivation is one of the most important keys to learning.�Moreover, increasing the motivation usually enhances the learning. If we are not  naturally motivated to participate in some activity, the motivation or interest must be created.�It is doubtful if we would learn if we were impelled by needs, faced with problems, or lured by rewards.�

When you are motivated to learn something, you become an active learner in your search for knowledge which give you personal power in a number of ways.�
